youtube.description:
5 prompts to start a Kiro spec (copy and paste)

Five prompts to start a Kiro spec with.

1. New feature - Build X for Y so they can Z.
2. Bug report - Describe the bug and the expected behavior.
3. Refactor - Name what must not change.
4. Add tests - Say which behavior needs coverage.
5. Explain first - Ask Kiro to explain before it builds.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/
